Description: Private host origin ingress — allows TCP 8080 only from the CloudFront VPC-origin service-managed security group.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: CloudFront VPC origin service SG -> host SG TCP :8080 -> private host proxy
must: Create this rule only after CloudFront has created the VPC origin and its AWS-managed service security group.
Deploy this regional EC2 security-group rule in the same Region/VPC as the host.
Do not allow public CIDRs or open any other host port.

HostSecurityGroupId.Description: SecurityGroupId output from the private host stack in ap-southeast-2.

CloudFrontServiceSecurityGroupId.Description: AWS-managed CloudFront-VPCOrigins-Service-SG ID created for the VPC origin. Retrieve it after VPC-origin creation; do not create or edit this group.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Opens only the private proxy listener after CloudFront's service-managed origin group exists; a security-group reference limits the path to the VPC-origin service.
must: Use the AWS-managed CloudFront VPC-origin security group as the sole source.
Allow TCP 8080 only; do not add CIDR-based or public ingress.

Properties.Description: CloudFront VPC-origin service to private host proxy only.
